reviewScope: Preview rows 22–41, one-based; assessment of proposed retrospective classification in the whole claim, not a date audit or identity approval.
interpretation: Supported refers solely to the later-reception classification, not all wording, identity, date, certainty, or audit status. All rows remain subject to independent date, identity, and publication gates.
